episodes.title: Lección 1: Prohibido enamorarse
episodes.summary: Chaperone Elena Bianda works to earn the trust of Pedro Mencía's daughters — and his attractive godson. At a high-society ball, things go out of control.

episodes.title: Lección 2: No contar mentiras
episodes.summary: Elena tries to support Cristina in the wake of her revelation. Sara shares her secret. A face from the chaperone's past makes an unwelcome appearance.

episodes.title: Lección 3: El pasado pasado está
episodes.summary: Both with ulterior motives, Gabriel and Cristina flirt with each other and confuse Santiago. Elena must confront secrets from her rebellious past.

episodes.title: Lección 4: Alejar la tentación
episodes.summary: After a night of indulgence, Cristina pleads with Elena to talk to Santiago, with unexpected results. Josefina and Esther struggle with their feelings.

episodes.title: Lección 5: No traicionar a tu señorita
episodes.summary: Elena tries to discourage Santiago's feelings while dealing with a rival chaperone. A betrayal surfaces during a séance. Cristina hears from Eduardo.

episodes.title: Lección 6: Tus deseos no son prioridad
episodes.summary: Complications almost expose Cristina's secret, and Elena resorts to asking Angustias for help. Santiago battles with doubts about Cristina.

episodes.title: Lección 7: Mantener las buenas formas
episodes.summary: Elena is stunned when her own mother tries to interfere with the Mencías, while Eduardo's return makes things even more confusing for everyone.

episodes.title: Lección 8: Hacer feliz a tu señorita
episodes.summary: After a shocking revelation, the sisters are furious with Elena. A professional opportunity for Santiago prompts Cristina to figure out her feelings.
